Are you planning to line up at the Apple Store to buy the iPhone Duo in person? Here's what Apple has said about in-store stock of the new device.

Here's Apple's official statement on iPhone Duo availability for in-store purchase at Apple Store

Last week, iPhone Duo pre-orders were almost immediately placed on backorder upon opening, and many people have already planned to go to Apple Store on October 23, hoping to buy one in person.

Apple today provided 9to5Mac with a statement explaining stock availability at stores worldwide.

Here's Apple's official statement:

"On Friday morning, our team looks forward to welcoming customers to Apple Store to experience the iPhone Duo and the exciting iPhone lineup in person. Apple Store will have a limited supply of iPhone Duo available for walk-in customers to purchase, and we will continue to work hard to get this revolutionary new product into customers' hands as soon as possible."

Apple has confirmed it has set aside some iPhone Duo units for walk-in customers at Apple Store. However, due to overwhelming demand, stock is expected to sell out very quickly.

Below are the countries where iPhone Duo will be available for walk-in purchase at Apple Store: United States, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Mexico, Germany, Macau, the Netherlands, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, the United Kingdom, and most stores in Italy.

The following regions only accept online orders with in-store pickup, with no walk-in purchase: Mainland China, France, Hong Kong, India, Japan, Malaysia, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, and the UAE.

If you can't get an iPhone Duo on launch day, the good news is that reports are gradually coming in showing iPhone Duo pre-order delivery dates are moving earlier.

Of course, not every order will be moved up. But if you haven't yet ordered the iPhone Duo, and you can't get one on Friday, the currently projected January shipping dates could be significantly earlier.

Are you planning to try your luck buying an iPhone Duo at Apple Store on Friday? How early will you line up? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
